triggers.name: Post Log On Trigger
triggers.description: Turns on the light after login.

triggers.name: Post Log Off Trigger
triggers.description: Turns off the light after logout.

triggers.name: Pre Operation Trigger
triggers.description: Blinks the light when calling for assistance.

triggers.name: Pre Elevate User Trigger
triggers.description: Stops blinking the light when manager override starts.

triggers.name: Operation Failure Trigger
triggers.description: Stops blinking the light if the operation fails.
